what: GPU perspective-stable pixel art (web/shaders/pixel/gpu.mjs) against the CPU reference (web/shaders/pixel/pixel.mjs)
compare: 8-bit sRGB per channel, all pixels, on the last frame of each case
why_looser: The probe marches rays in f32 on the GPU and f64 on the CPU; a ray that grazes a silhouette can hit on one side and miss on the other. At this test size one texel covers about a hundred output pixels, so a single disagreeing texel moves a block of pixels. The bound allows a few such texels per frame, not a systematic difference; a systematic one would move most pixels.
